CreateRenewResourceRule.accountId: Account ID; if omitted, defaults to the current logged-in account; if provided, only sub-account IDs that have joined the master account's financial group are supported, initiated by the financial group master account to manage resources on behalf of the sub-account
CreateRenewResourceRule.instanceId: Resource long ID, the unique UUID identifying the resource to be configured
CreateRenewResourceRule.renewTimeUnit: Auto-renewal time unit; only two values: month or year
CreateRenewResourceRule.renewTime: Auto-renewal duration; when renewTimeUnit is month, specifies the number of months (1–9); when renewTimeUnit is year, specifies the number of years (1–3)
